notes: Inline text link. Renders through Text atom for typography. For links that need visual weight (glass, pill, padding), use Button with href instead. All 4 renders use the same Link.astro — pipeline strips animation props in reduced/assistive/textonly. Textonly render: all links become plain underlined text (colour overrides, weight, uppercase all reset).

content._description: Where the link goes and how it identifies itself

external.description: External link — adds target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer.

variant.description: Visual indicator style. default=colour only, underline=static underline, highlight=subtle background, border=thin border, ghost=subtle colour.

color.description: Semantic text colour override. primary = brand primary, accent = brand secondary, text = body text, muted = secondary text, inherit = parent colour.

animation._description: Motion behaviour — stripped in reduced/assistive/textonly renders

underlineGrow.description: Underline scales from left on hover. Requires variant=underline for static fallback.

highlightGrow.description: Background highlight grows from bar to full coverage on hover. Requires variant=highlight for static fallback.

shadowFill.description: Box-shadow inset fills from left on hover. Works with any variant.

textSlide.description: Text colour sweeps from left via background-clip, with coordinated underline grow.

colour._description: Pipeline colour tokens — set as inline styles. 'auto' = pipeline resolves from context.
